The test image shows a soybean leaf with numerous small, scattered yellow-green spots on an otherwise dark green leaf. No necrosis, no brown lesions. This is a **leaf** disease, narrowing to 16 candidates.

Top candidates based on symptom descriptions:
- **Downy_mildew**: "Small light green spots on upper leaf surfaces"
- **Bacterial_Pustule**: "Small light green spots with raised centers"
- **Soybean_rust**: Small tan/brown spots with pustules
- **Bacterial_Blight**: Angular water-soaked spots

Let me view references one at a time, starting with my top candidates.
Downy mildew reference shows yellow-green spots but more advanced/coalescing. The test image has smaller, more discrete spots. Let me check Bacterial_Pustule.
That's a microscopic view. Let me check another Bacterial_Pustule reference.
Bacterial Pustule shows brown/reddish spots - doesn't match the yellow-green spots in the test image. Let me check Soybean_rust.
Soybean rust shows tan/brown/reddish small spots - not matching the yellow-green spots in the test image. Let me check Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus (mottling pattern).
BPMV shows puckering/mottling - different from the discrete small spots in the test image. Let me check Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus.
SVN shows larger irregular spots along veins - doesn't match the small discrete spots in the test image. Let me check Frogeye_leaf_spot.

Frogeye shows gray/brown spots with dark borders - not matching. My strongest candidate remains **Downy_mildew** based on the "small light green spots on upper leaf surfaces" description. Let me view another Downy mildew reference to confirm the early-stage appearance.

This is a strong match. This Downy mildew reference shows an early-stage infection with small, discrete yellow-green spots scattered on a dark green soybean leaf, very similar to the test image. The test image has more spots (slightly more advanced) but the same pattern: small, light green/yellow spots on the upper leaf surface.

Key evidence:
- Small light green/yellow spots on upper leaf surface matches Downy mildew description exactly
- No necrosis, no brown lesions, no raised pustules, no angular shapes
- Spots are discrete and randomly distributed across the leaf
- The Downy mildew early-stage reference (Soybean_Dise_75.jpg) is nearly identical in pattern to the test image
- All other candidates examined (Bacterial Pustule, Soybean rust, BPMV, SVN, Frogeye) showed distinctly different symptoms
